headline: Behemoth Units Cross the Copper Straits — UP War Enters New Phase
body:
Arcturus Defense has confirmed the deployment of four Behemoth-class autonomous war machines to the Upper Peninsula front as of 0300 hours this morning, marking the most significant escalation in the six-year resource conflict since the Sault Ste. Marie Accords collapsed in 2124. The Behemoths — designated AX-B9 through AX-B12 — each stand 34 meters at the shoulder and carry integrated Hellthread rail systems capable of sustained suppression fire across a 12-kilometer radius. Footage captured by embedded journalists and immediately flagged for review by Arcturus information control shows one unit crossing the Copper Straits on a temporary pontoon bridge, its silhouette visible from Meridian 88's northern tier districts. 'This is no longer a resource dispute,' says Yolanda Ferris-Nakamura, an independent military analyst based in The Circuit. 'This is occupation infrastructure.'

The deployment is formally contracted through Axiom, which holds extraction rights to the Upper Peninsula's remaining rare-earth mineral deposits — critical feedstock for SNT production and next-generation BCI hardware. Zheng-Dao has issued a formal protest through back-channel diplomatic feeds, claiming two of its surveying teams were killed in a Behemoth test-fire incident near Lake Gogebic on August 29th. Arcturus has not acknowledged the incident. The Federal Remnant's Northern Command has declared a 40-kilometer exclusion zone around the active front, grounding all civilian transit including Ferrogate's Overland Express routes.

Anti-war protests erupted in The Shelf and The Narrows within hours of the deployment confirmation. The Collective released a public statement calling the Behemoth deployment 'a war crime in slow motion, financed by mineral futures and paid for in bodies.' Casualty figures from the broader Upper Peninsula conflict remain disputed — Arcturus cites 1,200 combatant losses since 2119; independent monitors put the number closer to 8,000, including civilian deaths.
aftermath: The Behemoth deployment succeeded in securing three key mining corridors within ninety days, but the Lake Gogebic incident sparked a covert Zheng-Dao counter-operation that destabilized Axiom's UP supply chain for over a year.
runner_relevance: The Behemoth deployment and exclusion zone created immediate and sustained runner demand. Ferrogate's grounded Overland routes meant smuggling contracts for critical medical and food supplies to UP communities spiked to 6,000 phi per run. Zheng-Dao quietly funded extraction contracts to recover its killed surveyors' data cores from Arcturus-controlled territory — top-tier, high-risk at 15,000 phi. Anti-war groups hired courier runners to move protest materials through the exclusion zone. Bore Rats capitalized heavily, offering tunnel-route access to runners moving contraband under the blockade for a 20% cut. Axiom simultaneously posted sabotage prevention contracts protecting Behemoth logistics chains at 5,000 phi per week.
